name: tokenization-factory
description: Skills for issuers using Sara Tokenization Factory: project documentation, launch communications, listing and visibility, holder onboarding, and holder updates.

interface.longDescription: Create evidence-based tokenization project documents, launch materials, listing and visibility plans, holder-onboarding workflows, and holder updates. Intended for issuers using Sara Tokenization Factory. Outputs are drafts and plans, not legal, tax, investment, audit, valuation, or offering advice.
defaultPrompt: Create the project document for my tokenized asset.
Assess promotion constraints and build a launch kit for my token.
Design a holder-onboarding workflow for my token.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of five issuer workflows, with portable ChatGPT and Codex packaging and Claude Code marketplace support.
